en: Colorized vintage view of a tree‑lined open square with a prominent two‑story red‑brick railway station building in the center-right. The station has arched windows and an ornate entrance, with smaller wooden station buildings and a cart or wagon visible further back. The ground is unpaved and there are large leafy trees framing the scene. At the top center, red printed text reads "Karlshamn. Järnvägsstationen."
